item.title: Manual Testing & Process Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Definitions & Types)

  1. What is Manual Testing?
  2. Difference between Manual and Automation testing?
  3. What is a Test Case and what are its components?
  4. Difference between a Test Case and a Test Scenario?
  5. Explain Smoke testing?
  6. Explain Sanity testing?
  7. Difference between Smoke and Sanity testing?
  8. What is Regression testing and why is it needed?
  9. What is Retesting and how is it different from Regression?
  10. What is Unit testing?
  11. What is Integration testing?
  12. Explain System testing?
  13. What is UAT (User Acceptance Testing)?
  14. Explain Exploratory and Ad-hoc testing?
  15. What is White box and Black box testing?

Intermediate (Life Cycle & Bug Management)

  1. Explain SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle)?
  2. Explain STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle)?
  3. Explain the Bug Life Cycle in detail?
  4. What is the difference between a Bug, Defect, Error, and Failure?
  5. Explain Severity and Priority with real-time examples?
  6. How do you raise a bug? What steps do you follow?
  7. What are the common tools for bug tracking (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps)?
  8. What is the RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix)?
  9. What is a Test Plan and what does it contain?
  10. What is a Test Strategy?
  11. Explain Entry and Exit criteria in testing?
  12. What is Boundary Value Analysis (BVA)?
  13. What is Equivalence Partitioning (EP)?

Advanced (Management & Scenarios)

  1. How do you handle a situation where a developer rejects your bug?
  2. What will you do if a critical defect is found just before a release?
  3. Scenario: A production bug is found after sign-off. What is your approach?
  4. How do you decide which test cases to automate?
  5. What is Defect Density and Defect Leakage?
  6. Explain the difference between functional and non-functional testing?
  7. How do you prioritize test cases in a regression suite when time is limited?
  8. What is the impact of “Shift Left Testing” in your project?
  9. Explain SIT (System Integration Testing) and CIT (Continuous Integration Testing) environments?
  10. What are your roles and responsibilities in the current testing cycle?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Definitions & Types) - Answers

1. What is Manual Testing?

Answer: Manual testing is the process where a human tester executes test cases without using any automated tools. The tester plays the role of an end-user to find bugs and ensure the software meets the requirements.
